reason: Neither email is likely to win me back from a $25-a-visit saving, but A gives a concrete reason to trust the change: only 1 of 18 cleaners has left since July. It also explains the price difference by naming the $21 wage, which makes the $99 offer feel a little more worth trying. B's plain reminder of $165 after the first visit is honest, but it mainly reminds me how much I'm saving now.
